attributes.text: What it can and cannot do
attributes.originalText: What it can and cannot do

attributes.text: Here's what protection covers and how your information is handled:
attributes.originalText: Here's what protection covers and how your information is handled:

attributes.text: All analysis and protection happen directly on your device. When optional usage data is off, nothing is sent to our server.
attributes.originalText: All analysis and protection happen directly on your device. When optional usage data is off, nothing is sent to our server.

attributes.text: Protection reads the structure of the screen, not its text, so it works the same in any language.
attributes.originalText: Protection reads the structure of the screen, not its text, so it works the same in any language.

attributes.text: You can turn protection off at any time, in the app or in Android's accessibility settings.
attributes.originalText: You can turn protection off at any time, in the app or in Android's accessibility settings.

attributes.text: Changes to Instagram, TikTok or YouTube can affect how reliably protected screens are detected.
attributes.originalText: Changes to Instagram, TikTok or YouTube can affect how reliably protected screens are detected.

attributes.text: WHAT IT NEVER DOES OR COLLECTS
attributes.originalText: WHAT IT NEVER DOES OR COLLECTS

attributes.text: Does not save on-screen text or send screen information anywhere. Messages, passwords, photos and screenshots are never collected.
attributes.originalText: Does not save on-screen text or send screen information anywhere. Messages, passwords, photos and screenshots are never collected.

attributes.text: Does not include your name, messages or browsing history in usage reports. Sharing usage data is optional and off by default.
attributes.originalText: Does not include your name, messages or browsing history in usage reports. Sharing usage data is optional and off by default.

attributes.text: Does not show ads or sell personal data.
